neighbours.label: the point just before coming to know or realize something: 'to' in 'need to know / going to wake up / failing to realize', 'see the truth'
fire: Parents need to know that bullying is never the child's fault.
When are these politicians going to wake up and face reality?
Investors keep failing to realize how risky these loans really are.
Sooner or later everyone will see the truth about what happened.
Our students need to understand that mistakes are part of learning.
Anyone can see how absurd this proposal really is.
It took him years to realize that his father had been right all along.
Voters deserve to know what is in the agreement before it is signed.
quiet: Parents need to pack lunches before the school bus arrives.
When are these workers going to finish painting the fence?
Investors keep failing to sell their shares before the market closes.
Sooner or later everyone will get a seat on the bus.
Our students need to bring calculators to the exam tomorrow.
Anyone can buy a ticket at the station counter.
It took him years to build the cabin his father had designed.
Voters deserve to have polling stations close to their homes.

notes: Top examples: 'need⟦ to⟧ know this', 'going⟦ to⟧ wake up', 'failing⟦ to⟧ realize', 'we see the⟦ truth⟧', 'All can⟦ see⟧ how ridiculous'. The + pole is about reminders. Near misses keep 'to' and the frame but with a concrete physical action instead of knowing/realizing.
